serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: Oh no… Landlord: Hello, citizens! For some unworldly, unholy reason, the landlord appeared on screen… Landlord: Before the movie begins, I would like to take a minute of your time. Landlord: In these uncertain times everyone is looking for some stability and safety. And that’s exactly what we guarantee at my apartment building complexes! Landlord: A tight community and a landlord that will always listen to your troubles. Landlord: Sometimes it’s worth to pay a little more to get the treatment you truly deserve. You: … Landlord: Don’t wait! Affordable housing is a hot commodity these days. Call one of our agents now! Landlord: This paid ad was possible thanks to the local government’s grant for the most trusted entrepreneurs. Of course…{{wi}} My taxes paid for this propaganda… You: I don’t think I will be able to enjoy the movie after this… Soon after the movie began…
